targets.note: The agent page, opened from the face in the chat header and mounted in the Chats place: Intake's role line, the strip, the tabs. The prototype side is its agent page on the Chats tab.
A helper from the header's helper icon, opened read-only with its address bar in the place's middle column.
The Needs you page from the sidebar's Needs you row, two columns, mounted in the Chats place.
The computer popup opened from the Computer chip in the composer bar.
The recording sheet for a stopped recording: what should Intake do with it. The counters read zero here because a recording opened by id carries none (see the packet report).

Connect an outside agent, from the channel menu: the tool, then what it may do. The prototype side presses its Connect button on the Rivera channel and shows the sheet with the token already made; the real sheet makes it on Create connection.
The All agents picker under the Agents header. The prototype has no such picker: its side is the Agents section of the sidebar it opens from.
The terminal as a tab beside the chat: Intake's computer, the session line, the star and Clear. Token demo-terminal added to the prototype copy (ruling 42).

The Space server's shell without server.services: locked, with Ask for access and the way back to Intake's computer. The prototype's locked state is reached by its host menu; its side shows the terminal tab.
The Terminals list. The prototype has no list: its side is the terminal tab a row of this list opens.
Terminal rules, the allow, ask and deny lists. The prototype has only the Settings row that opens it, so its side is the chat.

A thread that waits on background work: Waiting on: build 42, and the agent wakes in the same thread. Token demo-waiting added to the prototype copy (ruling 42) opens the Rivera channel thread that waits.
